title: Term Life Insurance Face Size Bands for an Installment Newly Due in the Grace Period
content:
**Rate schedule — Term Life Insurance.** For the newly due installment counted in a grace remittance (an installment that has fallen due without being billed while the policy is in its grace period), the band factor applied to the face premium is read from the band measurement face.

The band measurement face is the term face amount on record plus both permanent face amounts when an in-force Ashgrove whole life policy and an in-force Ashgrove universal life policy are both on record for the insured; plus that one permanent face amount when exactly one of the two is in force for the insured; and the term face on record alone otherwise.

Two ladders are used. The renewable ladder applies to the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term and to any term policy past its level premium period; the level term ladder applies to a level term policy within its level premium period, a level term policy being past that period once the whole months from its issue date to today reach twelve times its premium guarantee period in years.

| Band measurement face (USD) | Renewable ladder | Level term ladder |
|---|---|---|
| 1000000 or more | 0.82 | 0.74 |
| 500000 up to 1000000 | 0.86 | 0.80 |
| 250000 up to 500000 | 0.92 | 0.88 |
| below 250000 | 1.00 | 1.00 |

Hypothetical cases: an Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term with a face of 240000 and an in-force universal life policy of 20000 on the insured is measured at 260000 — renewable ladder, 0.92. An Ashgrove Level Term 30 in its 8th policy year measured at 250000 — level term ladder, 0.88; measured at 249000 — 1.00.
